content.text:
I added `GET /api/messages/[id]` in `src/app/api/messages/[id]/route.ts`, backed by a new `getForRecipient` query in `src/repos/messages.ts`. The query filters on both the message id and the signed-in user as recipient, so anyone else, including admins and users of other practices, gets a 404. Unauthenticated requests get 401 from `requireUser`. The 200 body is exactly `{id, subject, body, sentAt, from:{name}}`, the message is marked read via the existing `markRead`, and an id-only audit entry is written.

The existing tests and typecheck pass (`npm run verify`). I did not add tests for the new endpoint, so the 404, 401 and mark-as-read behaviour is untested.
